comment: The functional checklist of the guesthouse brief (round 4), the same for the HTML and the Nyra version. check.js reads it. Every item is derived from a requirement of the brief; the method section of results/2026-10-20/REPORT.md says how each kind is checked. title: Penzion U Mlýna – riverside guesthouse in Český Krumlov
description: Family-run guesthouse in a restored mill on the Vltava, five minutes from the old town of Český Krumlov: six rooms, breakfast included, free parking.

clock.note: a Wednesday morning: the reception is open (Mon-Fri 7:00-21:00)

text: Český Krumlov · on the Vltava since 1998
Sleep by the river, wake up to the castle
Six quiet rooms in a restored 17th-century mill, five minutes' walk from the old town. Breakfast from our own bakery included.
Every room has a private bathroom, free Wi-Fi and breakfast included. Prices are per night for the whole room.
A window seat right above the weir.
Opens onto the herb garden and is quiet at night.
A double bed and a bunk bed under old oak beams.
Two bedrooms under the roof, ideal with older kids.
A free-standing bath and the best view of the castle tower.
A living room with the original mill wheel behind glass.
The quietest night we have had in years, and the croissants alone are worth the trip.
Our kids loved the bunk bed and the ducks on the river.
Five minutes from the old town, yet it feels like the countryside.
Tell us when you would like to come. We reply within a few hours with availability and the price.
Five minutes from the old town

items.a: Yes. Breakfast is served from 7:30 to 10:00 in the mill room or on the terrace.

items.q: Can I arrive late in the evening?
items.a: Yes. Tell us your arrival time and we will leave your key in a code box at the door.
We have eight free spaces in our courtyard. There is no need to book one.
Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. After that we charge the first night.
